newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC sees corporate demand for PCs rising.
newsitem.headline: NEC sees corporate demand for PCs rising.

text.p: NEC Corp expects corporate demand for personal computers to grow by 20 to 30 percent each year over the next two to three years, Koji Nishigaki, executive vice president of NEC, told a news conference on Thursday.
"We can expect strong demand for PCs in the corporate market to continue for the next 2-3 years. We can expect 20-30 percent growth," he said.
Nishigaki was referring to the overall PC market.
Earlier on Thursday, the company said it expects sales of its personal computers and related products in domestic and overseas markets to total 975 billion yen in the business year to March 31.
NEC, which is Japan's top personal computer maker, expects sales to rise another 20 percent next business year.
